summary: Item 5 (AI dashes sanitizer) and Item 8 (tagline) verified via code review + live smoke test on web landing and mobile login/signup. Mobile login + signup taglines render identical ('AGED CARE, MADE EASY') from shared BRAND_TAGLINE. Footer no longer says 'Made Clear' — now 'Aged Care, Made Easy.'. Sanitizer is applied to SmartAISummary body/alerts, CarePlanDetail finding titles/details, and meeting-artefact grouped titles. Two parity/coverage gaps found: (a) web hero-eyebrow renders 'AGED CARE, MADE EASY.' (trailing period) and both web hero + web footer HARDCODE the tagline instead of importing BRAND_TAGLINE — so they can silently drift from mobile; (b) sanitizeAI is NOT applied to `suggested_question` fields in CarePlanDetail (both FindingCard hint and MeetingArtefact verbatim question script), so an em/en dash in that LLM field would render un-sanitized. Regression: web landing loads clean, mobile login + signup load clean and both taglines render.

ui_bugs.issue: hero-eyebrow renders 'Aged Care, Made Easy.' with a trailing period; spec wants 'AGED CARE, MADE EASY' (no period). CSS uppercase gets the casing right but the period is still visible. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/DualFlagshipHero.jsx:68-71

Tagline is HARDCODED ('Aged Care, Made Easy.') in both places instead of importing BRAND_TAGLINE from /app/frontend/src/lib/brand.js. The stated goal of Item 8 (single source of truth so web + mobile cannot drift) is not achieved on web — mobile uses BRAND_TAGLINE, web does not. Reference: DualFlagshipHero.jsx:68-71, Footer.jsx:55-57

COPY.caregiver.eyebrow and COPY.participant.eyebrow both hold a duplicate 'Aged Care, Made Easy' string that is currently unused by the JSX (h1 hardcodes the same words again). Dead/duplicate copy — remove and drive from BRAND_TAGLINE. Reference: DualFlagshipHero.jsx:22, 29

integration_issues.issue: sanitizeAI() is applied to finding.title and finding.detail, but NOT to finding.suggested_question. The suggested question is LLM-generated and is rendered in two places without sanitization: (1) FindingCard 'Ask the provider' box, (2) MeetingArtefact verbatim question script (ordered list). Per Item 5, ANY AI-origin text must be run through sanitizeAI. Reference: /app/frontend/src/pages/CarePlanDetail.jsx line ~89 (FindingCard suggested_question) and line 211 ({f.suggested_question} inside <ol data-testid='question-script'>). Follow-up email modal (emailDraft.subject/body) is also un-sanitized LLM output.

parity_issues.issue: Web hero-eyebrow renders 'AGED CARE, MADE EASY.' (with a period), mobile login + signup render 'AGED CARE, MADE EASY' (no period). Not identical, contrary to Item 8.
parity_issues.expected: Identical wording on web landing, web footer, mobile login, mobile signup — sourced from a single constant.
parity_issues.actual: Web hero: 'AGED CARE, MADE EASY.' (period, hardcoded). Web footer: 'Aged Care, Made Easy.' (period, hardcoded, Title Case). Mobile login/signup: 'AGED CARE, MADE EASY' (no period, from BRAND_TAGLINE).

action_items: In /app/frontend/src/components/DualFlagshipHero.jsx: import BRAND_TAGLINE from '@/lib/brand' and render it inside the hero-eyebrow h1 (drop the trailing period, drop the split 'Aged Care,' / 'Made Easy.' spans, or keep the coloured second half but generate both halves from the constant). Remove the unused COPY.caregiver.eyebrow / COPY.participant.eyebrow duplicates.

In /app/frontend/src/components/Footer.jsx: import BRAND_TAGLINE and render it (footer intentionally shows Title Case + coloured 'Made Easy'; use CSS `capitalize` or derive Title Case from the constant instead of hardcoding).

In /app/frontend/src/pages/CarePlanDetail.jsx: wrap f.suggested_question with sanitizeAI(...) in BOTH the FindingCard 'Ask the provider' block AND the MeetingArtefact verbatim question script <ol data-testid='question-script'>. Also wrap emailDraft.subject / emailDraft.body in the follow-up email modal — those are LLM output too.
critical_code_review_comments: sanitizeAI coverage on web is partial: title + detail are covered, suggested_question and the follow-up email draft are not. Any em/en dash the model returns in those fields will bypass the sanitizer entirely.

Item 8 states the tagline is 'centralised into a shared constant'. On web, both hero and footer still hardcode the string. If someone edits BRAND_TAGLINE it will not update the web surface — the two platforms can and will drift.
Consistency: web hero has a trailing period ('AGED CARE, MADE EASY.'), mobile does not. Pick one and enforce via the shared constant.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Item 5 + Item 8 verified via code review + smoke test on web landing (hero-eyebrow, footer) and mobile /login + /signup (brand-tagline). Did NOT log in as Cathy because the two gaps are visible without auth. If retesting, log in as cathy@example.com / testpass123 and open a care plan with findings that include suggested_question strings to confirm the sanitizer gap on question-script. Mobile Expo preview: https://wayly-care-review.expo.preview.emergentagent.com (/login and /signup routes work directly).
rca of the issue: Item 8 (tagline centralisation) was completed on mobile (login.tsx and signup.tsx both consume BRAND_TAGLINE from mobile/src/config/brand.ts) but the parallel web change stopped at creating /app/frontend/src/lib/brand.js — the file exports BRAND_TAGLINE but no web component imports it. The hero (DualFlagshipHero.jsx:68-71) and Footer (Footer.jsx:55-57) still render literal strings, and the hero string has a trailing period the mobile string does not. Item 5 (AI dashes) was applied to summary/alerts (SmartAISummary) and finding title/detail (CarePlanDetail) but the sanitizer was not threaded into suggested_question (rendered twice on the CarePlanDetail page) or the follow-up email draft.
